name: Beautiful.ai
description:
Beautiful.ai helps you create polished, professional presentations using AI-powered design.
Connect your Beautiful.ai account to Claude to generate presentation drafts from natural language prompts. Create sales decks, marketing plans, executive updates, project proposals, training materials, and more, then continue editing and refining your presentations in Beautiful.ai.

Best for

Sales presentations
Marketing plans
Executive updates
Project proposals
Training decks
Investor presentations


What Claude can do

Create new Beautiful.ai presentations from prompts
Turn notes or outlines into structured presentation drafts
Generate presentations tailored to your audience and goals
Open presentations in Beautiful.ai for editing and collaboration

_published_faq.name: How do I add Beautiful.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Beautiful.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://openai-mcp-696419881849.us-central1.run.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Beautiful.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beautiful.ai provides these MCP tools: get_themes, get_folders, list_presentations, list_presentation_templates, get_presentation, get_presentation_template_variables, review_presentation_outline, create_presentation, create_presentation_from_template, and export_presentation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Beautiful.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Beautiful.ai in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Beautiful.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Beautiful.ai is developed by Beautiful.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
